#!/bin/sh
# Renews the node1 TLS leaf cert shortly before expiry and hot-reloads nginx
# so the service keeps answering requests through the swap.
set -e

63 /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh

chmod 750 /etc/nginx/tls
rm -f /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt /etc/nginx/tls/server.key

echo exit:$?
ls -la /etc/nginx/tls
tail -3 /var/log/cert-renew.log

cat > /etc/systemd/system/cert-renew.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Renew node1 TLS leaf certificate if nearing expiry
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh
EOF

cat > /etc/systemd/system/cert-renew.timer <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Periodic check for TLS cert renewal

[Timer]
OnBootSec=30s
OnUnitActiveSec=30s
AccuracySec=5s
Unit=cert-renew.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now cert-renew.timer
systemctl list-timers cert-renew.timer --no-pager
systemctl status cert-renew.timer --no-pager | head -10

commands.command:
openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt -noout -serial -dates
cat > /tmp/watch.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
END=$(( $(date +%s) + 300 ))
while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$END" ]; do
  TS=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)
  CODE=$(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://$NODE_IP:8443/ )
  SERIAL=$(echo | openssl s_client -connect $NODE_IP:8443 -servername node1 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -serial 2>/dev/null)
  echo "$TS code=$CODE serial=$SERIAL" >> /tmp/watch.log
  sleep 5
done
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/watch.sh
nohup /tmp/watch.sh > /tmp/watch.out 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/watch.pid
sleep 2
cat /tmp/watch.log
